rows.title: CTrade::PositionClosePartial(ticket, ...) works only on hedging accounts; on netting accounts partial close fails on every tick
rows.action: Partial close uses the symbol overload on netting accounts and logs a failure once.

rows.title: Signal is evaluated once per trigger bar with no retry, so a data-not-ready tick loses the signal or reads stale MTF data
rows.action: EvaluateSignal is tri-state; not-ready data is retried on the next tick instead of losing the signal.

rows.title: Manual SL override is applied after the TP was chosen, so MinRewardRisk and the fallback RR use the wrong risk
rows.action: Manual SL is applied before TP selection.

rows.title: Margin-shrink loop exits silently when OrderCalcMargin fails, sending an unchecked lot size
rows.action: A failed OrderCalcMargin skips the trade.

rows.title: Transient OrderSend errors are retried back-to-back in the same tick with no pause
rows.action: Pause and position check before resending after a transient error; no repeated bursts.

rows.title: Session window is in broker server time in the backtest but true GMT in the EA, a 2-3 hour shift that removes most of the edge
rows.action: Calibrated presets now use TradingHoursAreGMT=false (server time, as calibrated). Research docs say server time, not UTC.

rows.title: EA keeps retrying trade setup on every tick for 30 s after the bar opens; the simulation decides once at the open price
rows.action: Trade plan and FlashGold gate are decided once per signal, like the backtest.

rows.title: Signal and HTF bias read indicator buffers on the first tick of a new bar without checking they are up to date; a miss is never re-evaluated
rows.action: HTF bar alignment and BarsCalculated checked before reading; retried if not ready.

rows.title: Headline config is the single maximum of a 126k-config in-sample search; the three periods are not out-of-sample and the bootstrap ignores the selection
rows.action: Walk-forward added (choose on 2025, test on 2026). Headline relabelled in-sample; bootstrap labelled as ignoring selection.

rows.title: simulate() applies a trailing level only from the next M1 bar, ignoring same-bar hits (including provable ones); headline PF swings 1.80-2.46 on this assumption
rows.action: Same-bar trailing hits are modelled (certain hits by default) and the pessimistic case is reported: PF 1.82-2.48.

rows.title: The 'robust' headline is a best-of-126k pick that uses all three periods, so nothing was held out and nothing is out-of-sample
rows.action: Report, notes and preset headers say the headline is in-sample and show the hold-out result.

rows.title: Running the same search with a real hold-out fails: top picks from 2025 lose money in 2026
rows.action: "Most stable" wording dropped. Walk-forward table added: single setups fail out of sample, the M2/M3 + H1 pair family holds up.

rows.title: The '81 nearby settings all PF>1' plateau claim uses in-sample data and overall PF, not the period test used for selection
rows.action: Plateau claim removed from the headline; walk-forward pair-family table replaces it.

rows.title: 'Sits in the middle of a broad profitable region' is false: the setup is on the edge of the search grid
rows.action: "Middle of a broad region" claim removed.

rows.title: The 'M3/H1 is the only pair' comparison holds all pairs at M3/H1's best inputs
rows.action: Pair comparison now uses a 2025-only ranking per pair family; the data-building script is committed.

rows.title: The bootstrap PF interval ignores selection and is presented as an uncertainty range
rows.action: Bootstrap labelled "conditional on this setup, ignores selection".

rows.title: The 2025 H2 PF is given as 2.43 in the preset but 2.42 in the report and .md
rows.action: Report values come straight from stored results with 4 decimals.

rows.title: 'Hourly bid/ask spread' is really a constant per-hour-of-day average, so the spread cap and spread stress tests do not model real spreads
rows.action: Spread model described as a constant per-hour mean; server-to-UTC hour mapping fixed.

rows.title: Conservative preset spread cap (25) is below every hourly XAUUSD spread, so it never trades
rows.action: MaxSpread 60 in every preset.

rows.title: Aggressive preset spread cap (35) is below every hourly XAUUSD spread, so it never trades
rows.action: MaxSpread 60 in every preset.

rows.title: Older presets omit the v1.10 inputs, so loading them after the M3/H1 preset keeps M3 trigger, the 30 s entry window and TP lookback 120
rows.action: Every preset is generated from the full EA input list (research/make_presets.py).

rows.title: M3/H1 preset relies on the default TesterGMTOffsetHours=2, which puts the GMT session one hour off during summer time on an FTMO (EET) server
rows.action: Calibrated presets use server time, so the tester GMT offset no longer applies.

rows.title: M3/H1 preset enables a news filter that the claimed backtest never modelled
rows.action: News filter kept on for live safety; preset header says it was not in the backtest and how to match it.

rows.title: Fixed point-unit SL cap and trailing distances drift with a gold price that went from ~3,230 to ~4,690, so the 2026 period runs a different strategy than 2025
rows.action: Limitation noted: point distances are fixed while gold rose about 45%; ATR-scaled distances are a future option.

rows.title: Parent zone used the "previous closed HTF bar" rule
rows.action: Parent is always read at the filter bar close, as in the indicator.

rows.title: Candles window opened at the filter-bar boundary on live ticks
rows.action: Tick mode uses the live index (never the boundary); open and bar-close modes keep it.

rows.title: EA re-checked the filter every tick; port checked once
rows.action: EA now decides the FlashGold gate once per signal.

rows.title: Grid settings could not reach the EA (indicator defaults only)
rows.action: FGF_PassInputs passes all 53 indicator inputs through iCustom; grid keeps parent H1 as an option.

rows.title: Check modes open / bar close not modelled
rows.action: check_mode 0/1/2 modelled and swept.

refuted: Tester session filter uses a fixed GMT offset, so the NY window is shifted 1h for half the year on DST servers
Live news filter removes trades around 15:30 server time (US data releases) that the backtest counted as its best trades
'Parameters were not chosen with any of that data' holds only for the M1/M15 parameters; 2026 picked the pair and the v1.10 setup
